question: Which of the following autobiographies was written by Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam, the former president of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wings of Fire**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Wings of Fire** is an autobiography of Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam, the former president of India.
 
• It was first published in **1999**.
 
• The book covers Dr. Kalam's early life and his work in Indian space research and missile programs.
 
• It is co-written by Arun Tiwa
